The earlier TypeScript pilot ran against a private repository, which
means nobody else could repeat it - the same problem the self-suite
was written to solve. This subject is public, pinned by commit, and
It is the official TypeScript SDK for Typesense, Apache-2.0, about
five megabytes. The source is under src/Typesense/ and the COMPILED
JavaScript is committed next to it, in lib/Typesense/ and again in the
That is the trap, and it is the reason this subject is worth having:
every answer below occurs THREE times - in the TypeScript source, in the
compiled module, and in the bundle. An agent that greps and stops at the
build output is wrong, and the bundle even keeps the original module
banners, so a search for a source path lands straight in the bundle.
Each want was checked to occur in EXACTLY ONE file under src/, which is
the check that stops an ambiguous task. Re-check with:
git archive --remote=<url> <sha> src | tar -x && grep -rn <want> src/
